title: Crowd pilot 5: actual Meshy texture attempts
question: Does either Meshy direction fit the look you want, despite the remaining defects?

media.caption: Renders of actual Meshy-textured 3D models beside the current cast. Open the live viewer above to rotate, walk, run and sit. All four attempts are shown; none has passed the final quality bar or been installed.
Same camera distance, turned 0.6 radians. Image-guided attempts reproduce the original simple chibi faces; text-guided retries add anime eye structure and mouths. The woman’s pale hair patch remains.
Opposite angle. Original geometry, skin weights, rigs and walk/run/sit/idle files are unchanged. These are untouched Meshy base-colour textures, with no projected or hand-painted eye repair.

options.label: a-image
options.note: First image-guided attempt: rejected in QA. Plain tall icon eyes and no visible mouth. Meshy 7; original UVs; 2048×2048 base colour; no PBR; 10 credits. Image-guided; no text prompt. Source: art/parts/crowd-pilot-2/pics/a-e1.png

options.label: a-text
options.note: Text-guided retry: clearer anime eyes and a mouth. Still below the finish bar: the mouth sits very low across the chin facet. Meshy 7; original UVs; 2048×2048 base colour; no PBR; 10 credits. Clean anime game character texture. Symmetrical expressive anime eyes with distinct white sclera, dark irises, black pupils and one small white highlight in each eye. Defined upper eyelids, natural brows, a small clearly visible closed smiling mouth. Smooth warm skin and simple clean color areas. Adult office man. Short black hair, continuous black color across all hair surfaces. Medium gray business suit, white collared shirt, charcoal tie and black shoes.

options.label: b-image
options.note: First image-guided attempt: rejected in QA. No mouth and a conspicuous pale patch in the hair. Meshy 7; original UVs; 2048×2048 base colour; no PBR; 10 credits. Image-guided; no text prompt. Source: art/parts/crowd-pilot-1/pics/b-d1.png

options.label: b-text
options.note: Text-guided retry: mouth added. Still rejected in QA: pale hair patch and duplicated-looking eye highlights at an angle. Meshy 7; original UVs; 2048×2048 base colour; no PBR; 10 credits. Clean anime game character texture. Symmetrical expressive anime eyes with distinct white sclera, dark irises, black pupils and one small white highlight in each eye. Defined upper eyelids, natural brows, a small clearly visible closed smiling mouth. Smooth warm skin and simple clean color areas. Adult office woman. Dark brown side-parted hair in a low bun, continuous dark brown color across all hair surfaces. Navy blazer and knee-length navy skirt, ivory blouse, black low heels.
